function.name: company_research_exa
function.description: Research companies using Exa AI - finds comprehensive information about businesses, organizations, and corporations.

companyName.description: Name of the company to research

numResults.description: Number of search results to return (default: 5)

function.name: competitor_finder_exa
function.description: Find competitors for a business using Exa AI - identifies similar companies, competitive landscape analysis, and market positioning.

companyName.description: Name of the company to find competitors for

function.name: crawling_exa
function.description: Extract and crawl content from specific URLs using Exa AI - retrieves full text content, metadata, and structured information from web pages.

url.description: URL to crawl and extract content from

function.name: deep_researcher_check
function.description: Check the status and retrieve results of a deep research task.

taskId.description: The task ID returned from deep_researcher_start tool

function.name: deep_researcher_start
function.description: Start a comprehensive AI-powered deep research task for complex queries.

instructions.description: Complex research question or detailed instructions for the AI researcher

function.name: github_search_exa
function.description: Search GitHub repositories and code using Exa AI - finds repositories, code snippets, documentation, and developer profiles on GitHub.

query.description: GitHub search query (repository name, programming language, username, etc.)

searchType.description: Type of GitHub content to search (default: all)

numResults.description: Number of GitHub results to return (default: 5)

function.name: linkedin_search_exa
function.description: Search LinkedIn profiles and companies using Exa AI - finds professional profiles, company pages, and business-related content on LinkedIn.

query.description: LinkedIn search query (e.g., person name, company, job title)

searchType.description: Type of LinkedIn content to search (default: all)

numResults.description: Number of LinkedIn results to return (default: 5)

function.name: research_paper_search_exa
function.description: Search for academic papers and research using Exa AI - specializes in finding scholarly articles, research papers, and academic content.

numResults.description: Number of research papers to return (default: 5)

function.name: web_search_exa
function.description: Search the web using Exa AI - performs real-time web searches and can scrape content from specific URLs.

numResults.description: Number of search results to return (default: 5)

function.name: wikipedia_search_exa
function.description: Search Wikipedia articles using Exa AI - finds comprehensive, factual information from Wikipedia entries.

query.description: Wikipedia search query (topic, person, place, concept, etc.)

numResults.description: Number of Wikipedia articles to return (default: 5)
